name: job-card
title: Repair job card
for_each: SELECT t.id,t.ref FROM tickets t JOIN stores s ON s.id=t.store_id

sections.title: Bench notes
sections.sql: SELECT actor,note,created_at FROM events WHERE ticket_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at

name: collection-receipt
title: Collection record
for_each: SELECT t.id,t.ref FROM tickets t JOIN stores s ON s.id=t.store_id

sections.title: Repair and recorded balance
sections.note: Recorded invoice and payment snapshots. This document is not a tax invoice or a payment receipt.

sections.title: Checks and handover
sections.sql: SELECT qa_note,qa_by,collected_at,warranty_until FROM tickets WHERE id=$1
sections.note: A shop warranty date does not determine statutory consumer rights.

name: repair-notice
title: Australian repair notice
for_each: SELECT t.id,t.ref FROM tickets t JOIN stores s ON s.id=t.store_id WHERE s.country='AU'

sections.title: Notice given under the Australian Consumer Law
sections.sql: SELECT ref,device,serial FROM tickets WHERE id=$1
sections.note: Repairing this device may cause loss of stored user data. Back up your data before repair.

sections.title: Refurbished goods and parts
sections.sql: SELECT ref FROM tickets WHERE id=$1
sections.note: Goods presented for repair may be replaced by refurbished goods of the same type rather than being repaired. Refurbished parts may be used to repair the goods.

sections.title: Delivery evidence
sections.sql: SELECT notice_at,notice_ref,accepted_at FROM tickets WHERE id=$1
sections.note: DRAFT for review. Provide the written notice before acceptance for repair. Rendering this file does not prove delivery. Use only for a shop whose refurbishment practice matches the notice. Source: https://www.accc.gov.au/consumers/problem-with-a-product-or-service-you-bought/repair-notices

name: claim-record
title: Customer remedy record
for_each: SELECT t.id,t.ref FROM tickets t JOIN stores s ON s.id=t.store_id

sections.title: Device
sections.sql: SELECT ref,device,serial FROM tickets WHERE id=$1

sections.title: Claims and follow-ups
sections.sql: SELECT issue,status,follow_up_on,resolution FROM claims WHERE ticket_id=$1
sections.note: Assess statutory rights separately from the shop warranty. No automatic refusal or remedy decision.
